question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi></math> is the altitude of a parallelopiped determined by the vectors <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and the base is taken to be the parallelogram determined by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>19</mn><msup><mi>h</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is

solution.text:
Volume of the parallelopiped =a^ b^ c^

⇒ (area of the base parallelogram) ×h=a^ b^ c^

⇒a^×b^h=a^ b^ c^

⇒-5i^+3j^+2k^h=11124-1113

⇒38h=4⇒h=438

⇒38h2=42⇒19h2=8

Hence, option (c) is correct.
